consumed_rule: node.id appears in json.loads(recall_events.results)[].node_id of an event whose created_at is strictly greater than the node's created_at
grounded_rule: the consuming event was closed by a memory_remember trace (feedback_trace_id not null) whose content grounds the node at IDF containment >= min_containment
notes: cohort is every nodes row in the window, all levels, decayed included; level='trace' only does not reproduce the published baseline
grounded.rate divides by nodes_with_closed_consumer, not by the cohort: most recall events carry no feedback_trace_id
dividing grounded consumption by the whole cohort understates it several-fold; that figure is published as grounded.rate_over_cohort
consumed_later is a lower bound on usefulness: a node never delivered again may simply never have been queried for
this artifact republishes finished-tool aggregates; it re-implements no measurement
no node content and no verbatim query appears here, by construction and by check_privacy
the absolute floor is protocol-scoped: 0.15 was calibrated on the July retrospective rate 0.4942 and is not meaningful under the counterfactual replay protocol
the same 949-node organic holdout scores 0.1317 under replay set >= 2026-08-15 and 0.4373 under >= 2026-08-12, a 3.32x swing from replay-set choice alone
under the pinned >= 2026-08-15 arm a 0.15 floor would reject the known-good organic control itself (counterfactual 0.1159), so the bar as first published could only return FAIL
the bar was amended before any extracted cohort existed and before any code read pre_registered_bar, so it is still pre-registration

pre_registered_bar.absolute_floor_deprecation_note: the scalar absolute_floor is retained only as an alias of absolute_floor_by_protocol.retrospective_long_window; readers must key the floor by protocol, never read the scalar

counterfactual_post_cutoff: 0.05 is anti-degenerate only: at least one cohort node in twenty must resurface in delivered results.
It sits 2.3x below the organic control 0.1159 measured under the same protocol (self_check.primary.counterfactual_rate), so traces consumed as well as organic memory clear it.
The July constant 0.15 exceeds that same organic control and therefore cannot apply to this protocol.
retrospective_long_window: 0.15 is the original July calibration: about 0.30x the retrospective organic reference 0.4942 over 2026-07-01..2026-08-01.
It is defensible only for full-history retrospective measurement over a window of weeks, which is the protocol it was calibrated on.

absolute_floor_role: The absolute floor is a backstop, not the test: it exists only to stop a degenerate near-zero extracted cohort from passing on a collapsed organic reference.
It is not a quality target and carries no protocol-invariant meaning: the same 949-node organic cohort scores 0.1317 or 0.4373 depending only on which recorded traffic is replayed.
A floor above the organic control measured under the same protocol makes the gate unfalsifiable, because it can then only return FAIL.
amendment: The first publication registered a protocol-blind scalar floor of 0.15, calibrated on the July retrospective rate 0.4942.
Under the pinned replay set >= 2026-08-15 the known-good organic holdout scores 0.1159 counterfactual and 0.1317 retrospective, so the 0.15 floor would have rejected organic-quality memory.
A gate that cannot pass a cohort consumed exactly as well as organic memory is not falsifiable; the floor is therefore keyed by protocol and the replay set is pinned to the self-validated arm.
Amended while nothing read pre_registered_bar and no extracted cohort existed, so this is pre-registration, not post-hoc relaxation.
decision_procedure: 1. Measure both cohorts under one protocol, one replay set and one --as-of; name the protocol key in the verdict.
2. If the concurrently measured organic control fails inconclusive_rule admissibility, stop: the verdict is INCONCLUSIVE, never PASS.
3. PASS requires extracted_rate >= relative_floor * organic_rate; this relative test is the primary, protocol-invariant one.
4. PASS also requires extracted_rate >= absolute_floor_by_protocol[protocol], the anti-degenerate backstop.
5. Otherwise FAIL. Report protocol, replay set, both rates and both floors next to the verdict.
pre_registered_bar.decision_rule: PASS iff the organic control is admissible AND extracted_rate >= 0.5 * organic_rate AND extracted_rate >= absolute_floor_by_protocol[protocol]; an inadmissible control gives INCONCLUSIVE, never PASS
pre_registered_bar.grounded_variant_note: the grounded variant divides by nodes_with_closed_consumer, so an extracted-vs-organic grounded comparison must compare rate to rate, never counts

measured_control_margin: The 2026-08-19 organic control 0.1159 clears min_control_rate_by_protocol 0.1 by only 1.16x, so admissibility must be rechecked on every run and never assumed.
That control cohort holds 949 nodes, comfortably above min_control_nodes.
inconclusive_rule.min_control_nodes_derivation: below 100 cohort nodes the binomial standard error at rate 0.12 is 0.033, two thirds of the 0.05 floor, so the control cannot discriminate
inconclusive_rule.min_control_rate_derivation: admissible iff organic_rate >= 2 * absolute_floor_by_protocol[protocol], which is exactly when the relative floor 0.5 * organic_rate is the binding condition
inconclusive_rule.note: INCONCLUSIVE says the harness produced no usable reference this run; it judges the control, not the extracted cohort, and must not be reported as either PASS or FAIL
inconclusive_rule.trigger: the concurrently measured organic control is itself too weak to discriminate: its rate falls below min_control_rate_by_protocol, or its cohort below min_control_nodes

pre_registered_bar.organic_reference_note: the runner must recompute the organic reference under its own protocol; this value is the 2026-08-19 measurement, not a constant
pre_registered_bar.protocol: extracted and organic cohorts must be measured under the IDENTICAL protocol: same tool, same --as-of, same within_days, same min_containment, same replay set

counterfactual_post_cutoff: Snapshot, remove the cohort, re-insert it, then replay recorded recall queries through the current retrieval code.
Consumed means the cohort node appears in the delivered results of a replayed query.
This is the protocol an extracted cohort is actually in: written at one instant, it can only be consumed by traffic recorded later.
retrospective_long_window: Read-only join of nodes against recorded recall_events.results over a creation window of weeks, with no replay.
Consumed means the node id appears in a recorded event created strictly later than the node.
Unavailable to a fresh extracted cohort, which has no weeks of recorded later traffic yet.

pre_registered_bar.relative_floor_note: the 0.5x comparison against a concurrently measured organic control is the primary and protocol-invariant test: both cohorts absorb the same replay drift, so their ratio survives it

replay_set_rule.predicate: every replayed event's created_at must be strictly later than the MAXIMUM created_at in the cohort, so the replay set is strictly post-cutoff for both cohorts alike
rationale: The pinned arm is the only one that cleared the harness's own 10-point self-validation bar: gap 0.0158 against 0.1296 for the >= 2026-08-12 arm.
It also matches the situation an extracted cohort is in: written at one instant, it can only be consumed by traffic recorded after it.
Replay-set choice alone moved the same 949-node organic cohort by 3.32x (0.1317 against 0.4373), so the set is pinned once, never chosen per run.
Comparing an extracted cohort measured under one replay set against an organic control measured under another is void, whatever the two rates are.

pre_registered_bar.why_pre_registered: the bar is fixed before the extractor writes anything, so it cannot be relaxed to fit a disappointing result

provenance.as_of_semantics: cuts BOTH nodes and recall_events on created_at <= as_of, so the run is reproducible as the live DB keeps growing
provenance.merge_rule: windows.<W> and per_agent.<W>.<agent> copy cohorts[id=='all'|'agent=<name>'] of the matching run; self_check copies $.selfcheck and $.diagnostics.alternate_replay
provenance.privacy_guard: living_memory.postsession.usage_metric.check_privacy (SAFE_STRING ^[\x20-\x7e]{0,200}$) ran over this whole document before it was written

question: what share of organically written memory was actually delivered by a LATER recall, and what bar must extracted traces clear

alternate_replay_set.why_published: the verdict depends on WHICH recorded traffic is replayed; the weaker arm is published, not hidden

self_check.caveat: only the post-cutoff arm >= 2026-08-15 clears the 10-point bar (gap 0.0158 vs 0.1296), so it is pinned; the floor is protocol-scoped since this arm puts the organic control at 0.1159, not 0.4942
self_check.cohort_rule: nodes.created_at in [2026-08-12,2026-08-15) UTC at as_of 2026-08-19T00:00:00Z; all levels, decayed included, no agent/context filter; disjoint from every published baseline cohort
self_check.purpose: the counterfactual harness must reproduce a KNOWN organic rate before it may judge extracted traces
